summary: The original Calc Format Page Style slot edits the shared document style through native item-set transactions and can undo and redo the change.
findings: Page geometry, header/footer settings, print flags, scale, border and solid color use actual native items and ODS persistence. The shared metric adapter preserves CUI dependency direction and Writer behavior.
evidence_refs: 42 Calc and 87 Writer tests, TypeScript, generated resources, source provenance, file size, lint, dependency checks and the production Chrome replay passed.
residual_risks: Header/footer content editing, graphic fills and printer-driven pagination are separate native mechanisms.
